name: Thousand Needles
summary: In southern Kalimdor, Thousand Needles stands over a dry canyon of sandstone pillars. Tauren hold the mesas, while gnomes and goblins race rocket cars across the Shimmering Flats.

sections.title: A Forest of Stone
sections.body:
Before the Great Sundering, inland waterways fed a lush river canyon that ran toward the sea. The cataclysm shattered ancient Kalimdor, raised the riverbed above the water table, and changed the river's course. Dry stone and sandstone spires remain. Dozens of slender, cylindrical columns rise from the canyon floor like a forest turned to stone.

Tauren built villages atop the columns and joined the peaks with precarious rope bridges. They sought escape from hostile centaur marauders patrolling the shadow-draped floor below.

sections.title: Peril on the Mesas
sections.body:
Life atop the needle-like spires is far from peaceful. At Freewind Post, tauren loyal to the Horde face predatory wind serpents and wyverns from Highperch, and treacherous kin of the militant Grimtotem clan, entrenched at Darkcloud Pinnacle. Cliffwatcher Longhorn directs the plateau's defense. He seeks bold fighters to strike Grimtotem agitators and secure the fragile bridges between peaks.

To the north, enormous mechanical winches at the Great Lift carry travelers down from the southern Barrens. Crossing the canyon floor remains a deadly gamble.

sections.title: The Mirage Raceway
sections.body:
To the southeast, the canyon walls open onto the Shimmering Flats, an enormous dried-up salt pan below sea level. Gnomes and goblins keep an uneasy neutrality around the Mirage Raceway in this harsh, blinding expanse. Rival engineers Pozzik and Fizzle Brassbolts race experimental rocket cars across the hard salt, each seeking to prove their race's technological superiority.

The pit stop draws scoundrels, swindlers like Kravel Koalbeard, and hunters pursuing the hardy scorpions, turtles, and basilisks that roam the searing basin.

faq.q: How did Thousand Needles get its name?
aliases: why is it called thousand needles
faq.answer: Thousand Needles takes its name from the dozens of massive, cylindrical sandstone spires rising from the canyon floor. Rushing rivers carved them before the Great Sundering, and now they resemble a forest of giant needles.

faq.q: How do you get down into Thousand Needles from the Barrens?
aliases: how to get to thousand needles
faq.answer: Travelers ride the Great Lift, an immense double-car elevator run by Horde guards on the Barrens' southern border. A fall from the edge is fatal, so wait for the platform. Alliance travelers can also hike in from the west through Thalanaar in Feralas.

faq.q: Why do the tauren live on top of the mesas?
faq.answer: Centaur warbands once drove the nomadic tauren nearly to extinction. Outposts like Freewind Post, atop inaccessible stone pillars, kept them safe from centaur ground charges. Wooden suspension bridges linked the mesas, letting tauren travel above the predators and raiders below.

The Mirage Raceway is an engineering proving ground on the Shimmering Flats salt pan. Gnomish and goblin tinkerers race experimental rocket-propelled cars across the flat salt bed to settle their rivalry over which race builds the finest machinery.

faq.q: What is the Grimtotem presence in the canyon?
faq.answer: The Grimtotem clan occupies Darkcloud Pinnacle, a fortified cluster of spires directly opposing Freewind Post. Unlike the other tauren tribes, who pledged to the Horde, the Grimtotem attack their kin and conspire to dominate the mesas.

The Shimmering Flats are a vast, dried lakebed east of the canyon mesas. Its salt crust formed when the ancient inland sea evaporated after the Sundering. Searing heat, blinding white salt, and harsh predators make it an inhospitable desert used mainly for high-speed vehicle testing.

angles.text: As a tauren, you can see how high your people climbed to escape centaur slaughter. Freewind Post is also a staging ground against the treacherous Grimtotem at Darkcloud Pinnacle.
At the Mirage Raceway in the Shimmering Flats, you can show the precision and elegance of gnomish engineering beside shoddy goblin contraptions.
The salt flats draw tinkerers seeking to study rocket fuel, vehicle parts, and high-speed propulsion at the Mirage Raceway.
The Great Lift links the Barrens to your stronghold at Freewind Post, marking a strategic southern boundary against centaur clans and rebel tauren.
